Subject: Runway assessment: delivery probability matrix & leadership asks

Team — attaching a compact delivery-probability matrix for the May–June slate (file: launch_probability_matrix.xlsx). I created this to make the QBR conversation more decision-oriented: per-feature probability to ship by target date, primary dependency, and a short recommended leadership action.

High-level asks: 
- Please review the probabilities for the features you own and add one-sentence rationale in column G by EOD Monday.
- Engineering: flag any hard blockers that will change the probability by >20 points.
- CS/Customer: confirm whether a slip of up to two weeks is acceptable for Acme (Jordan is copied).

I'm especially calling out the integration with Dedicated routing (INF-4321) — if we can't cut the perf delta, we should plan a staged rollout. I want a decision from senior leadership by 2027-05-29 so we can bake the ask into the QBR narrative.

Attachments: launch_probability_matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra

Folks — engineering update and risk register snapshot attached (risk_register_snapshot.csv). Key items that change probabilities materially: 

1) Dedicated routing perf (INF-4321) — current perf delta ~18% on P99 for long-sequence workloads. Root cause: KV cache eviction behavior under mixed batch sizes. Mitigation: change to prefetch policy + micro-batching; estimate 5 working days to validate across benchmarks (probability to fix in time: 60%).

2) Model quantization vectorization — some quant kernels regress on a subset of 7-layer attention patterns; workaround is to pin to the safe quant profile for shipping (probability to ship with pinned profile: 85%).

3) Integration testing with partner infra (edge gateway) — test harness shows intermittent auth token timeouts; suspected flaky load balancer config on partner side. Need a 48-hour joint run with Ops/Partner teams.

I updated the matrix with per-feature probabilities and short mitigation notes. For the Green/Amber/Red rollup Vivek requested, I suggest the following thresholds: Green >= 80%, Amber 50–79%, Red < 50%.

Requests: 
- Exec decision on whether to accept a staged rollout for Dedicated routing or to move to a feature-flag-only launch.
- Two extra SRE days for expanded soak testing on staging (cost ~2 engineer-days).

Irene Choi
Director, Engineering
Redwood Inference
